title: Northgate Credit Cards Product Changes on a Membership Tier Change
content:
Northgate member services rule on moving a Northgate Credit Cards account to another card product when the tier of its linked membership changes.

## Rule

When the linked membership moves to a tier outside the card's listed membership tiers — an upgrade to a Plus tier, or a downgrade from one — the account moves to the card product's change target. A product change is made only on an account whose status is active. The card number and history are kept where the card product keeps them on a product change, rewards already earned stay on the account, and the new product's rates apply from the point the card product's terms set for a product change. A store card has no product change; a member who wants a Visa product applies for it.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Condition | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| The linked membership's new tier is outside the card's listed membership tiers | The trigger holds | The account moves to the card product's change target |
| The card account's status, as its own record shows it | Active | The product change is made |
| The card account's status | Restricted, closed or any status other than active | No product change is made |
| The card is a store card | It has no product change | A member who wants a Visa product applies for it |

## What carries across the change

- **Card number and history** — kept where the card product keeps them.
- **Rewards already earned** — stay on the account.
- **Rates** — the new product's rates apply from the point the card product's terms set.

## Cases (hypothetical members)

- A member whose consumer membership is upgraded to a Plus tier holds an active consumer Rewards Visa product that does not list that Plus tier. The account moves to that product's change target; the rewards already earned on it stay on the account.
- A member holding an active Plus Rewards Visa product downgrades the linked membership from the Plus tier. The new tier is outside the card's listed tiers, so the account moves to that product's change target.
- The same upgrade happens while the card account is restricted. No product change is made while the account is not active.
- A member holding the Northgate Store Card upgrades to a Plus tier and asks for a Visa product. The store card has no product change; the member applies for the Visa product.
